CREATE TABLE `referral_credit_ledger` (
  `user_id` int NOT NULL,
  `account_revision` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `event_kind` varchar(24) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `source_key` char(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `previous_balance` decimal(20,8) DEFAULT NULL,
  `delta` decimal(20,8) DEFAULT NULL,
  `resulting_balance` decimal(20,8) NOT NULL,
  `migration_run_id` char(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin DEFAULT NULL,
  `source_sha256` char(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `recorded_at_utc` datetime(3) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`user_id`,`account_revision`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_referral_credit_event` (`user_id`,`event_kind`,`source_key`),
  KEY `fk_referral_ledger_run` (`migration_run_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_referral_ledger_account` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `user_referral_accounts` (`user_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_referral_ledger_run` FOREIGN KEY (`migration_run_id`) REFERENCES `data_migration_runs` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_referral_ledger_amount` CHECK (((`event_kind` = _utf8mb4'opening') or ((`resulting_balance` = (`previous_balance` + `delta`)) and (((`event_kind` = _utf8mb4'order_debit') and (`delta` < 0) and (`resulting_balance` >= 0)) or ((`event_kind` in (_utf8mb4'order_release',_utf8mb4'commission_credit')) and (`delta` > 0)))))),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_referral_ledger_kind` CHECK ((`event_kind` in (_utf8mb4'opening',_utf8mb4'order_debit',_utf8mb4'order_release',_utf8mb4'commission_credit'))),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_referral_ledger_shape` CHECK ((((`event_kind` = _utf8mb4'opening') and (`account_revision` = 1) and (`previous_balance` is null) and (`delta` is null) and (`migration_run_id` is not null)) or ((`event_kind` <> _utf8mb4'opening') and (`account_revision` > 1) and (`previous_balance` is not null) and (`delta` is not null) and (`migration_run_id` is null))))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
